description: This file contains functions for generating account balance timeline data for dashboards in the ERPNext system, including data retrieval, date calculations, and balance computations.

methods.name: build_result
methods.description: Calculates balance values over a series of dates based on GL entries and account type.

methods.name: get_gl_entries
methods.description: Retrieves GL entries for an account and its descendants up to a specified date.

methods.name: get_dates_from_timegrain
methods.description: Generates a list of period-ending dates based on the specified time grain between from_date and to_date.
